Entertainment -WILL BE GIVEN AT- Masonic Temple, Monday, April 24th, 7:30 P.M., UNDER THE AUSPICES OF THE- DISTRICT AUXILIARY Blue Anchor Association, FOR THE RELIEF OF THE Sufferers by the Mississippi Flood. ADMISSION FREE:

All are invited, and are requested to bring or send donations of Groceries or clothing old or new. R. O. POLKINHORN, PRINTER.
